featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing and disturbing experience with Sachin Dhamale and Pritam Dhamale.

It is shocking to see individuals openly operating in the real estate market while carrying such a discriminatory and prejudiced mindset. During the conversation, they very confidently stated that they do not entertain Muslims, Bengalis, and certain other communities for rental dealings because of their “past experiences.” Hearing such blatant discrimination in 2026 is honestly disgraceful and unacceptable.

What was even worse was the manner in which the conversation was handled. The moment they assumed I belonged to one of the communities they dislike, the tone became rude, dismissive, and arrogant. I was bluntly told that if I belonged to those categories, I should not even continue the discussion, after which the call was disconnected on my face.

When I called back seeking clarification regarding such behaviour, instead of professionalism or basic courtesy, I was met with excuses, passive aggression, and an attempt to portray themselves as victims for being questioned about their own words and conduct.

My concern comes from a genuine experience involving a family member who approached them for assistance in finding a place. Unfortunately, the experience exposed a very troubling side of how they deal with people behind the façade of being a “top agency” in Chunabhatti.

Professionalism in real estate is built on trust, ethics, and respectful treatment of clients — not on prejudice, ego, or selective discrimination. No matter how established an agency may appear, behaviour like this speaks volumes about the people running it.

Strongly disappointed and would never recommend dealing with individuals who normalize discrimination and disrespect while claiming to be professionals.
